courses.title: Prompt Engineering Mastery
courses.tagline: Write prompts that reliably get the answer you want
courses.description: Master the craft of instructing large language models. Learn frameworks for clarity, constraints, chain-of-thought, few-shot patterns, and evaluation loops so your prompts work across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and open models. Built for practitioners who want reproducible results—not lucky one-offs.

reviews.name: Maya Chen
reviews.text: Cut my revision cycles in half. The few-shot templates alone paid for the course.

reviews.name: Jordan Blake
reviews.text: Finally a prompt course that teaches evaluation—not just magic phrases.

reviews.name: Priya Nair
reviews.text: Clear, practical, and model-agnostic. Wish the advanced section were longer.

reviews.name: Sam Okonkwo
reviews.text: Our team standardized on these patterns. Onboarding new hires is way faster.

courses.title: AI for Work: ChatGPT & Claude
courses.tagline: Ship better writing, research, and decisions every day
courses.description: A practical operating system for knowledge work with ChatGPT and Claude. Cover email, docs, meeting notes, research synthesis, spreadsheets, and stakeholder communication—with guardrails for accuracy, privacy, and tone. Ideal for PMs, marketers, analysts, and operators.

reviews.name: Elena Vogt
reviews.text: I use the meeting-notes workflow daily. Managers noticed the quality jump.

reviews.name: Chris Patel
reviews.text: Best “get productive this week” AI course I’ve taken. No fluff.

reviews.name: Aisha Rahman
reviews.text: Great Claude vs ChatGPT comparisons. Helped me pick the right tool per task.

courses.title: Generative Media: Image & Video with AI
courses.tagline: Produce scroll-stopping visuals without a studio
courses.description: Learn modern image and short-form video generation—from Midjourney/Flux-style prompting to editing, consistency, and brand-safe workflows. Cover storyboarding, style references, upscaling, and light motion for social and product storytelling.
curriculum: Prompting for style, lighting, and composition

reviews.name: Diego Alvarez
reviews.text: My client decks look like they came from an agency. Consistency tips were gold.

reviews.name: Hannah Lee
reviews.text: Finally understand when to regenerate vs edit. Saved hours of thrash.

reviews.name: Omar Farouk
reviews.text: Strong on images; video section is a great launchpad for further practice.

reviews.name: Nina Kowalski
reviews.text: The brand kit workflow is what I use for every campaign now.

courses.title: AI Agents & Automation Bootcamp
courses.tagline: Build agents that research, decide, and take action
courses.description: Go beyond chatboxes. Design tool-using agents, multi-step workflows, and automations that connect APIs, docs, and browsers. Learn planning, memory patterns, guardrails, evaluation, and when not to agentify a process.

reviews.name: Alex Rivera
reviews.text: Went from demos to a production research agent. The eval module is unmatched.

reviews.name: Taylor Kim
reviews.text: Clear on when agents fail. Saved us from overengineering a simple Zap.

reviews.name: Ben Novak
reviews.text: Dense but worth it. Pair with the prompting course if you’re newer to LLMs.

courses.title: No-Code Machine Learning Intuition
courses.tagline: Understand models without drowning in math
courses.description: Build real intuition for classification, regression, embeddings, and evaluation—using visual tools and no-code platforms. Perfect for PMs, founders, and designers who need to talk ML fluently and make better product bets.
curriculum: Train / validate / test without the jargon trap
Reading metrics that matter to the business

reviews.name: Sofia Mendes
reviews.text: I finally get embeddings. Conversations with our ML team are night and day.

reviews.name: Ryan Cooper
reviews.text: Great intuition builder. Not a coding bootcamp—and that’s the point.

reviews.name: Leila Hassan
reviews.text: The metrics chapter alone is worth the price for product folks.

reviews.name: Marcus Webb
reviews.text: Solid pacing. Would love a follow-up on LLMs vs classical ML tradeoffs.

courses.title: AI Strategy for Creators & Founders
courses.tagline: Turn AI into leverage—not another shiny tool
courses.description: A strategy course for indie creators, solopreneurs, and early-stage founders. Map your value chain, pick high-ROI AI bets, productize workflows, price digital offers, and build a moat that isn’t “we use ChatGPT.”
curriculum: AI opportunity mapping for your niche

reviews.name: Zoe Mitchell
reviews.text: Reframed how I package offers. Booked two new clients with the case-study system.

reviews.name: Ivan Petrov
reviews.text: Strategic without being vague. Concrete frameworks I reused the same week.

reviews.name: Grace Park
reviews.text: The moat chapter is refreshingly honest. No hype, just leverage.

reviews.name: Noah Berg
reviews.text: Excellent for founders. Creators may skip one module—still highly recommend.

courses.title: AI for Sales & Outreach
courses.tagline: Research, sequences, and CRM-safe messaging that still sound human
courses.description: A practical sales OS with AI—prospect research, personalized outreach, call notes to CRM, follow-up sequences, proposals, and brand/compliance guardrails. Built for SDRs, AEs, and founders who sell.

reviews.name: Alex Rivera
reviews.text: Our SDRs stopped sending robotic AI emails in a week. The CRM notes module alone was worth it.

reviews.name: Samira Patel
reviews.text: Finally a sales+AI course that won’t get you in trouble with Legal. Guardrails are practical.

reviews.name: Chris Nguyen
reviews.text: Strong on sequences and personalization. Wanted one more proposal template—still shipped faster.

reviews.name: Jordan Lee
reviews.text: Founder-seller here. Research → outreach → follow-up OS is exactly what I needed.

reviews.name: Casey Morgan
reviews.text: We finally shipped Vendor Triage as a real team assistant—not another fragile prompt paste.

reviews.name: Riley Santos
reviews.text: The knowledge boundary module stopped our hallucinated SLA problem cold.

reviews.name: Avery Quinn
reviews.text: Practical and model-agnostic. Wanted even more on actions, but the safety framing is excellent.

reviews.name: Morgan Lee
reviews.text: Rollout playbooks + golden sets made our GPT library something people trust.

reviews.name: Casey Morgan
reviews.text: Our ops team finally trusts the handbook bot—citations changed everything.

reviews.name: Riley Okonkwo

reviews.name: Sam Park

reviews.name: Jordan Ellis
reviews.text: Grounded answers + refusal patterns stopped our hallucination incidents cold.

courses.title: AI Music Production
courses.tagline: Write, generate, arrange, and ship tracks with AI music tools
courses.description: A practical music OS with AI—song briefs, lyrics & structure, generation loops, arrangement & mix notes, rights & release, and a weekly ship cadence. Model-agnostic (Suno/Udio-style). Built for creators who ship.

reviews.name: Maya Ortiz
reviews.text: Finally a music+AI course that starts with briefs and taste locks instead of one vendor’s UI tour. Shipped my first clean single in a week.

reviews.name: Devon Blake
reviews.text: The rights and release checklist alone saved us from a messy upload. Model-agnostic advice actually transfers.

reviews.name: Priya Shah
reviews.text: Hook-writing and arrangement maps are excellent. Wanted one more DAW edit demo—still worth it.

reviews.name: Chris Alvarez
reviews.text: Weekly music OS turned random prompting into a ship cadence. Northstar scenarios feel real without being risky.

courses.title: AI Image Studio

courses.description: A stills-only creative OS with AI—visual briefs, prompt control, character and product locks, edit/upscale, brand kits, and client-safe delivery. Model-agnostic depth on consistency (deeper than a generative-media survey).

reviews.name: Riley Chen
reviews.text: Finally a stills course that treats consistency like a system. Our campaign sets actually match now.

reviews.name: Morgan Ellis
reviews.text: Brand kit + rights modules are practical. Loved the no-likeness rule framed for real client work.

reviews.name: Avery Brooks

reviews.name: Quinn Sato
reviews.text: Model-agnostic prompting for control—exactly what we needed after tool-hopping for months.

reviews.name: Quinn Nakamura
